title: Battery Drain
summary: Workflow for repeated dead battery after sitting, separating weak battery, charging issue, and parasitic draw.
intro: A battery drain complaint is not automatically a bad battery. The useful split is whether the battery fails capacity testing, the alternator does not recharge it, or a draw remains after shutdown.
common_sounds: Battery dead after sitting overnight or several days
Jump start works, then problem returns
Interior light, module, or accessory stays awake
Slow crank with no obvious charging warning
quick_checks: Charge and load test the battery first
Verify alternator output after the engine starts
Inspect terminals, grounds, and aftermarket accessories
Measure key-off draw after modules time out

diagnostic_path_sections.title: Battery and Charging Path
diagnostic_path_sections.summary: Confirm battery capacity and charging output before spending time on draw isolation.
checks: Load test battery after full charge
Check charging voltage with loads on

diagnostic_path_sections.title: Parasitic Draw Path
diagnostic_path_sections.summary: If battery and charging pass, isolate excessive key-off draw without waking modules repeatedly.
checks: Let modules sleep before draw measurement
Check glove box, trunk, vanity, and aftermarket loads
Pull fuse paths only after baseline draw is confirmed

recommended_repairs.title: Battery Replacement
recommended_repairs.description: Use after capacity testing confirms the battery will not hold charge.

recommended_repairs.title: Alternator Replacement
recommended_repairs.description: Use when low charging output is confirmed with a known-good battery.
